## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:cli` · `area:workflow`, into `pm:queue`. The family's closing card, with the enumeration pin. Direction: rebind (B), refusing what cannot be rebound

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-11T12:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Lane:** `peelToBlockBody` in `packages/cli/src/utils/extract-hook-body.ts` is `domain:cli`.
- **Why p2:** a handler that passes every in-process test answers `500` once deployed. That is the family's grade.
- **This amends my #22810 grade (`6107382836`).** "Passes in-process, fails once lowered" had already reached its third member there (#14010, #16249, #22810), and the family rule gives the third occurrence a closing card with an enumeration pin. I graded it as one more measured case. This card, the fourth, takes the closing role. #22810 stays in flight as filed (PR #22834).
- **Direction for this member: (B) rebind, with (A) as the residue.**
  - The family refuses members the VM **lacks** (`.sudo(`, `.create(`, `scope`, `submitted`): nothing can supply them.
  - A parameter **name** can be supplied. Emit the handler's first parameter as a binding of `ctx` in the lowered body: `const <param> = ctx;` for an identifier, or `const <pattern> = ctx;` for a destructuring pattern. The author's code then runs as written.
  - Refuse (A), naming the parameter, only what cannot be rebound faithfully: more than one parameter, a default value, or a rest element. Use the family's refusal wording.
- **The enumeration pin, which closes the family:**
  - **Derive, don't list:** take the members `buildSandboxContext` (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts`) marshals, against the members of the in-process `HookContext`.
  - Every member present in-process and absent in the body must be either refused at lowering (`FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS`) or recorded as a deliberate, test-named exception. The test fails when a new `HookContext` member is added without one or the other.
  - Pair it with the parity door: `lowered-body-door.dogfood.test.ts` (PR #22834) runs each handler shape in-process and lowered, and requires the same outcome or a lowering refusal. Its `lbd_param` cell moves from documenting the `500` to proving the rebind. ⛔ It is never deleted.
- **Sequence:** PR #22834 (#22810) edits the same file. Pick this card up after it merges. This is ordering, not a block.
- `Clause-②: no` for the rebind, which accepts nothing new and runs what the source runs. `yes` (narrowing) for the residue's refusals.

Seat: `domain:cli#1`
File surface: `packages/cli/src/utils/extract-hook-body.ts` (`peelToBlockBody` and the emitted body: the parameter rebind, and the residue's refusal beside the family's `FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS`), `packages/cli/src/utils/lower-callables.ts` only if the rebind must be emitted there, their `packages/cli` tests, the family's enumeration pin (a new test in `packages/cli` or `packages/qa/dogfood` that derives the body face from `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts` and the in-process `HookContext`, READ, not edited), `packages/qa/dogfood/test/lowered-body-door.dogfood.test.ts` (the `lbd_param` cell moves from documenting the `500` to proving the rebind, ⛔ never deleted), `content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx` if a sentence there becomes false, and one `.changeset/22837-*.md`. **Widened by edit before the ACCEPT** (PR #22859): `packages/cli/src/utils/detect-free-identifiers.ts` and its test (the `parseFunction` span check, an in-place fix under the bounded exemption), `packages/cli/src/lint/hook-body-lowering.ts` and its test (the hook face passed to extraction), `packages/cli/src/hook-body.ts` (docblock only), `packages/cli/test/hook-body-parameter-rebind.test.ts`, `packages/cli/test/lowered-body-face-enumeration.test.ts` (the family's enumeration pin), and the pin's two declared cross-package reads in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `turbo.json`. ⛔ No `packages/runtime` or `packages/spec` edit. Read on `origin/main` `1eff3224d` at 2026-10-11T13:13Z. Stop on a breach and explain it in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: "no path-derived mandate", floor · default · ceiling). Not mechanical: a parameter rebind in a regex-based lowering, and a derived enumeration pin that must be able to fail. The residue's refusals narrow what `objectstack build` lowers, so one contract-review-tier review is owed before the queue.
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Corrected by edit from `no (narrowing)` on the contract-tier record `6110348222` (FAIL on `a27cba278`): the `parseFunction` span fix widens one shape at two doors, and `hook-bodies.mdx:169` does not cover it. Seat answer `6110191438` is superseded.
Responsibility: `extractHookBody (packages/cli, this lane) drops the handler's parameter list while the sandbox binds only ctx, so a handler naming its parameter otherwise is lowered at exit 0 and ReferenceErrors | none: nothing refuses it, and the artifact door answers 500 | any author whose handler parameter is not the identifier ctx and who deploys the compiled artifact; measured through bootStack's artifact door by the #22810 dev`
Thread-read: 6109239514
Serial constraints cleared: PR #22834 (#22810) merged as `1eff3224d7`, so `extract-hook-body.ts` and the dogfood pin are free. No open PR touches `extract-hook-body.ts`, `lower-callables.ts`, the lint rule or `lowered-body-door.dogfood.test.ts` (every open PR's file list read). #22841 (this lane, queued, unclaimed) also names `extract-hook-body.ts` (the `hook-body/*` messages); it is held behind this card. #22839 (this lane, in flight) edits `compile.ts` only.

If that review finds the citation below does not cover the shape, the line drops to `yes (narrowing)` (`execution-duties.md`: 引文不符 ⇒ 降为 yes) and this seat corrects the claim, the PR body and the changeset.

**Why `no`:** removing a false refusal that published contract text already denies is `no`, provided the `no` cites that text.
- **The shape:** a method shorthand with exactly one nested function, closing over a method local.
- **Before the fix:** it was refused as `free-identifiers`. `parseFunction` returned the NESTED function, so the method's own local read as free.
- **The published text it contradicted:** `content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx:169` (on `main`), in the list of sources the CLI builder rejects: "references to identifiers from value-only top-level imports". A method's own local is not a top-level import.
- The extractor's own rule says the same (`detect-free-identifiers.ts`, module docblock): free means "bound neither by the function (params, locals) nor by the JS runtime".
- **The span check** makes the parse pick the handler itself. That repairs a refusal the text never authorised, and widens nothing the text denies.

Everything else in the PR narrows: the residue's refusals, and the three newly refused members `ctx.provenance`, `ctx.ql` and `ctx.transaction`.
